summary: Security update for the Linux Kernel
details:
The SUSE Linux Enterprise 16.0 kernel was updated to fix various security issues:

The following security issues were fixed:

- CVE-2026-31708: smb: client: fix OOB read in smb2_ioctl_query_info QUERY_INFO path (bsc#1264022).
- CVE-2026-31709: smb: client: validate the whole DACL before rewriting it in cifsacl (bsc#1264024).
- CVE-2026-43350: smb: client: require a full NFS mode SID before reading mode bits (bsc#1264985).
- CVE-2026-46155: smb/client: fix out-of-bounds read in smb2_compound_op() (bsc#1267720).
- CVE-2026-53288: arm64: Reserve an extra page for early kernel mapping (bsc#1269813).
- CVE-2026-64370: posix-cpu-timers: Fix pid refcount leak in do_cpu_nanosleep() error path (bsc#1273805).
- CVE-2026-64413: netfilter: ebtables: zero chainstack array (bsc#1274082).
- CVE-2026-64430: NTB: epf: Avoid calling pci_irq_vector() from hardirq context (bsc#1274257).
- CVE-2026-68140: net/iucv: fix use-after-free of a severed iucv_path (bsc#1275581).
- CVE-2026-68186: binfmt_misc: set have_execfd only once the interpreter is opened (bsc#1274949).
- CVE-2026-68337: bpf: Reject redirect helpers without a bpf_net_context (bsc#1274635).
- CVE-2026-68383: drm/xe/guc: Keep scheduler timeline name alive (bsc#1274816).
- CVE-2026-68436: drm/amd/display: use kvzalloc to allocate struct dc (bsc#1276275).
- CVE-2026-68447: drm/amdkfd: clamp v9 CRIU control stack checkpoint copy to BO size (bsc#1276280).
